items.heading: Cevapi Serbian
details: Key ingredients: minced beef and pork, onion, somun bread, ajvar
Mix minced beef and pork with onion and seasoning.
Shape into small grilled sausages.
Grill over high heat until well charred and juicy.
Serve in warm bread with chopped onion and ajvar relish.

items.heading: Karadjordjeva Snicla
details: Key ingredients: veal, cheese, breadcrumbs, egg
Pound veal thin and wrap it around a filling of cheese.
Roll and secure the veal, then bread it in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry until golden and crisp.
Serve with tartar sauce and a side of fries.
